title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 352
text:
339 has determined that the terms “woman”, “man” and “sex” in the
EqA 2010 refer to a person’s biological sex. Woman has always meant biological woman. Man
has always meant biological man. Sex has always meant biological sex. See the Equality Act

2010 appendix for an overview of the EqA 2010 and more detail of the application of the EqA

2010 to “sex”.

338 For the practical effect, see HM Attorney General and (1) Akhter (2) Khan and others [2020] EWCA Civ 122.

339 For Women Scotland Ltd v The Scottish Ministers [2025] UKSC16.
